topic: 条件状语从句与虚拟语气 (Conditionals and Subjunctive Mood)
teaching_notes:
1.【核心概念】：条件句就像一个“逻辑开关”！如果触发了“条件”（If从句），就会产生“结果”（主句）。小学阶段我们学习“真实条件句”（现实中极可能发生的事或客观真理）；中学阶段进阶到“平行宇宙/虚拟语气”（假设与现实相反的遗憾或幻想）。
2.【口诀与公式】：
- 小学核心【主将从现】：If 从句用一般现在时，主句用一般将来时（will/can + 动词原形）。
- 中学进阶【时态降格降阶法】：
  ① 与现在相反：从句用过去式（be动词全用were），主句用 would/could + 动词原形；
  ② 与过去相反：从句用 had + done，主句用 would/could + have + done；
  ③ 倒装省略句：省略 if，把 Had / Were / Should 提前置于句首！
3.【中小学生避坑指南】：
- 坑1：If 从句千万不要加 will！（错：If it will rain tomorrow... ❌ 对：If it rains tomorrow... ✅）
- 坑2：unless 意思是“除非”（等于 if... not），后面绝对不能再接否定词 not，否则就变成了“双重否定”！
- 坑3：虚拟语气中，与现在相反时，无论主语是 I/he/she，be 动词一律优先用 were。
4.【经典例句】：
- ① If you heat ice, it melts.（零级条件/客观真理：如果你加热冰，它就会融化。）
- ② If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home.（一级真实条件：如果明天下雨，我们就留在家。）
- ③ If I had studied harder last semester, I would have passed the exam.（三级虚拟条件：如果我上学期更努力一点，我就通过考试了。）

questions.question: If it _____ tomorrow, we will cancel our outdoor picnic.
questions.explanation: 考查【主将从现】规则。在 if 引导的条件状语从句中，主句用一般将来时（will cancel），从句必须用一般现在时（rains）表示将来。

questions.question: You will get good marks in the exam if you _____ hard every day.
questions.explanation: 考查【主将从现】。主句是 will get，if 从句使用一般现在时 work，主语为 you 用动词原形。

questions.question: If water reaches 100 degrees Celsius, it _____.
questions.explanation: 考查【零级条件句（客观真理）】。描述客观科学事实时，主句和从句都使用一般现在时（reaches ... boils）。

questions.question: Unless you _____, you will be late for the morning assembly.
questions.explanation: 考查【unless 辨析】。unless 意为“除非”，本身已包含否定意味（if you don't），从句需用肯定形式 hurry。

questions.question: What will you do if your computer _____ down during the test?
questions.explanation: 考查【主将从现】。特殊疑问句主句用了 will do，if 从句主语是第三人称单数 your computer，动词用 breaks。

questions.question: If Lily _____ her homework early tonight, she can watch cartoons.
questions.explanation: 考查【主情从现】。主句带有情态动词 can，if 从句同样用一般现在时，Lily 为第三人称单数，填 finishes。

questions.question: Please call your mother as soon as you _____ at the train station.
questions.explanation: 考查【时间状语从句主祈从现】。as soon as（一……就……）引导的时间状语从句中，主句是祈使句（Please call），从句用一般现在时 arrive。

questions.question: We won't go swimming if the sea water _____ too cold.
questions.explanation: 考查【主将从现】。主句是 won't go，if 从句主语 sea water 是不可数名词，be 动词一般现在时形式为 is。

questions.question: If you don't eat a proper breakfast, you _____ hungry later in the afternoon.
questions.explanation: 考查【主将从现】。从句使用了否定形式 don't eat，主句应用一般将来时 will feel。

questions.question: Don't open the door for anyone unless you _____ who is outside.
questions.explanation: 考查【祈使句 + unless】。unless 本身表否定，后接一般现在时肯定形式 know。

questions.question: If Tim _____ enough pocket money, he will buy that comic book.
questions.explanation: 考查【主将从现】。Tim 是单数第三人称，have 的一般现在时三单形式为 has。

questions.question: If it is fine this Sunday, my family _____ camping near the lake.
questions.explanation: 考查【主将从现】。从句是一般现在时 is fine，主句需补齐一般将来时 will go。

questions.question: You should wear a heavy jacket when it _____ cold outside.
questions.explanation: 考查【时间状语从句】。when 引导的时间状语从句中，主句用情态动词 should wear，从句用一般现在时 gets。

questions.question: If you mix red and yellow, you _____ orange.
questions.explanation: 考查【零级条件句】。颜色的混合属于客观科学事实，主从句均用一般现在时（mix ... get）。

questions.question: Unless he _____ for his mistake, I will not talk to him again.
questions.explanation: 考查【unless 语法细节】。unless 从句用一般现在时，主语 he 为三单，因此使用 apologizes。

questions.question: If I _____ a bird, I would fly across the vast ocean.
questions.explanation: 考查【与现在事实相反的虚拟语气】。从句谓语动词用过去式，若为 be 动词，无论主语单复数，标准语法中一律用 were。

questions.question: If he had woken up ten minutes earlier this morning, he _____ the school bus.
questions.explanation: 考查【与过去事实相反的虚拟语气】。从句用 had + done，主句结构为 would/could/should/might + have + done，故选 wouldn't have missed。

questions.question: I wish I _____ the answer to this complex physics problem right now.
questions.explanation: 考查【wish 后的虚拟语气】。表示对“现在”情况的虚拟假设，宾语从句动词需用一般过去时 knew。

questions.question: If you _____ harder last semester, you would be at the top of the class now.
questions.explanation: 考查【错综时间条件句（混合虚拟）】。从句是对过去发生的假设（last semester），用 had studied；主句是对现在结果的假设（now），用 would be。

questions.question: Supposing it _____ tomorrow, what would we do about the open-air concert?
questions.explanation: 考查【与将来事实相反的虚拟语气】。从句表示对将来不可能或可能性极小情况的假设，可用 were to + 动词原形/did/should + 动词原形。故选 were to rain。

questions.question: _____ I known that you were ill in hospital, I would have visited you immediately.
questions.explanation: 考查【虚拟语气倒装省略句】。当虚拟条件句省略 if 时，必须将 had, were 或 should 提到句首。原句为 If I had known... 倒装为 Had I known...

questions.question: If the sun _____ to stop shining, all living organisms on Earth would perish.
questions.explanation: 考查【将来虚拟 (were to)】。太阳停止发光是极不可能发生的将来假设，用 If ... were to stop结构。

questions.question: She talks about Paris as if she _____ there for years, but in fact she has never been abroad.
questions.explanation: 考查【as if/as though 虚拟语气】。表示对过去事实的虚拟假设（她从未出国，却说得好像过去在那里住过很多年一样），从句动词用过去完成时 had lived。

questions.question: _____ you require any further technical assistance, please do not hesitate to contact us.
questions.explanation: 考查【正式公文中的条件句倒装】。原句为 If you should require... 省略 if 后将情态动词 Should 提至句首，常用于商务信函。

questions.question: It is high time that we _____ effective measures to protect endangered species.
questions.explanation: 考查【It is high time (that)... 句型】。该句型从句谓语动词需用一般过去时（took）或 should + 动词原形（should 绝对不可省略）。

questions.question: If the surgeon had not performed the operation immediately, the patient _____.
questions.explanation: 考查【与过去相反的虚拟主句】。从句 had not performed，主句对过去的虚拟应为 would have died。

questions.question: I would rather you _____ anyone about our private conversation yesterday.
questions.explanation: 考查【would rather 虚拟语气】。would rather 后接宾语从句，若针对“过去发生的事（yesterday）”，从句动词必须用过去完成时 had not told。

questions.question: Without your generous financial support, our non-profit project _____ last year.
questions.explanation: 考查【含蓄条件句（介词介导虚拟）】。介词 Without 代替了条件从句，针对过去时间（last year），主句谓语用 couldn't have been completed。

questions.question: _____ it not been for the heavy morning traffic, we would have arrived at the airport on time.
questions.explanation: 考查【固定虚拟句型倒装】。原句为 If it had not been for...（要不是因为……），省略 if 后倒装为 Had it not been for...

questions.question: If the Universe _____ at a slightly different rate after the Big Bang, life as we know it could never have emerged.
questions.explanation: 考查【高考/考纲压轴级过去虚拟】。大爆炸（Big Bang）是发生在过去的确定历史事件，假设其以不同速率膨胀是对过去的虚拟，故从句使用过去完成时 had expanded。
